canonical_name: Creatives Over Easy: A Monthly Soul Reset
summary: A monthly drop-in creative-reflection circle at Story Parlor in West Asheville, facilitated by creative empowerment coach J. Faye D'Avanza, who calls it 'my version of a creativity support group.' Sessions combine themed group readings (The Artist's Way, The Creative Act) with guided sharing and reflection, i.e. peer participation rather than one-way instruction. No evidence of dues, a roster, or a dedicated Facebook/Meetup community was found, and the listings never name returning attendees, but the support-circle format and consistent monthly cadence with one facilitator plausibly draws a recurring core.

evidence.note: Listing describes a monthly drop-in group with guided sharing, group reading, and discussion rather than a class or performance.
Same format repeats on a second monthly cadence (third Sundays) at the same venue with the same facilitator initials (jfaye).

Profile of facilitator J. Faye D'Avanza quotes her calling the gathering 'my version of a creativity support group'; article notes no membership/dues language, just open monthly drop-in participation.

Web search found no dedicated Facebook group, Meetup page, or independent website for Creatives Over Easy itself; all references point back to Story Parlor's own calendar or the facilitator's personal Substack.
